headline: Ethereum leads TVL at $36.7B; USDT at $173.5B on 26 Nov 2026
summary: Ethereum holds the top position in chains TVL at $36.68B, followed by Base at $5.11B and Solana at $4.60B. Uniswap V3 recorded the highest DEX volume at $1.06B over 24 hours while Tether generated $17.1M in fees. USDT and USDC dominate stablecoin circulation with minor 1-day changes, though several peg alerts remain active. Multiple incidents occurred in the past 14 days, primarily on Solana and BSC.
